topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how Darwinian selection acts on genetic mutations and epigenetic changes to drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and the cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment and inflammation in tumor promotion
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how inflammatory stimuli and supportive stromal environments act as non-mutagenic promoters to drive tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Methodologies for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It details the experimental and computational tools used to map clonal evolution and cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of evolutionary forces in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions collectively orchestrate cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
